# The Grimoire

The Grimoire is our set of reading notes on the phone's own system software: the kernel extensions and the boot stage,
decompiled from the owner's own firmware. Each entry says which function does what, which values it uses, what we
verified and every question we could not close. It is the shortcut for readers who want the kernel's side of the story
before, or instead of, the observations on the phone.

Nothing here is Apple's code: an entry records addresses, constants, structure and our conclusions. A claim
marked *device disassembly verified* was read in the code; it has not necessarily been seen working on the phone, and
the open questions say what proof is missing.
